policy: Frozen M21 settings; no per-set mana fitting. First six UUID-ordered ordinary nonlegendary high-resolution nonfoil cards per material calibrate printed-frame gradient templates (or half smaller groups); next six validate. Independent frame-only translation/uniform scale, strict rejection gates. Same scan pose for both renders; no glyph alignment.

decision: Shared frozen settings admitted for M15 and WAR. M21 remains supported by its independent study. Do not generalize the full profile to every modern set: DMU regresses, and DSK has conflicting fixed-position ink and whole-mana results.

flaggedForReview.reason: Both frozen font and geometry ablations reduce fixed-pose overlap; isolate the remaining mana-row/frame placement error before adoption.
Whole mana improves, fixed-position ink regresses; separate placement from source identity. Only four glyphs passed the original strict circle mask in this diagnostic.
Six colored costs slightly reduce available title width; 1,614 title pixels change. Candidate not adopted for DSK.

shapeDiagnostic.policy: Diagnostic only: compare glyphs in their own measured discs, separately with and without ink-bounds normalization. Never changes renderer, scan transforms, whole-card metrics, or original fixed-mask transfer scores. Separates font shape from currently displaced mana rows.
